# Key Tips and Reminders for Your Commercial Learner’s Permit Test (CLP) Day


Your CLP test day is here (or almost here!), and we’re cheering you on! To help you feel confident and prepared, here are some tips and reminders to make sure you’re set up for success.


## **1. Bring Your Documents**


Make sure you have these five key documents with you:


• **Your DOT Card**


• **Social Security Card**


• **Birth Certificate or Passport**


• **Driver’s License** (cannot be expired)


• **Utility Bill**


• **Proof of Name Change** (if applicable)


Double-check that you’ve gathered everything the night before to avoid any last-minute stress.


## **2. Arrive Early**


Getting to the DMV early gives you time to settle in, avoid rushing, and calm your nerves. Aim to arrive at least 30 minutes before your scheduled test time to account for any unexpected delays.


## **3. Take Your Time**


During the test, remember to breathe. After each question, take a moment to think carefully before answering. This isn’t a race—your goal is to pass, not finish quickly. Slowing down and focusing can help you avoid simple mistakes.


## **4. Skip If You Don’t Know the Answer**


You only need to get 80% correct to pass, so don’t panic if you come across a tough question. If you’re unsure, skip it and come back later instead of making a rushed guess. Focus on the questions you know to maximize your score.


## **5. Don't Use Your Phone**


Put away your phone and anything else that might pull your attention away from the test. Texting or looking at your phone during the exam is not allowed and **will** disqualify you.


## **6. Ask Questions If You’re Unsure**


If something is unclear before you begin the test, don’t hesitate to ask a DMV employee for clarification. It’s better to get the information you need upfront than to guess.


## **7. What If You Don’t Pass?**


If you don’t pass this time, don’t worry—it happens. Before leaving the DMV, make sure to ask about your next steps and what options you have for retaking the test. Once you know the plan, notify your Success Coach so they can support you.


## **8. What If You Pass?**


Congratulations! If you pass the test, talk to the DMV about getting your physical CLP permit. Once that’s sorted, be sure to notify your Success Coach so they can guide you on the next steps in your journey.


## **Final Thoughts**


You’ve got this! Remember, preparation is key, and a calm, focused mindset will help you succeed. If you have any last-minute concerns or questions, don’t hesitate to reach out to your coach or the DMV staff. Best of luck—we can’t wait to celebrate your success!


**Let’s go get that CLP!** 🎉
